purpose: Group evidenced target units into centralized, modular, or explicitly seam-backed extraction boundaries.
evidenceRule: Every context and extract cites target unit IDs and coupling or seam evidence.
instructions: Act as the system architect for the full target map. Prefer a modular ColdBox monolith. Consider an isolated ColdBox module or a microservice/side-app only when evidence supports the boundary. Use explicit-seam only for genuine runtime/deployment and data-boundary evidence; domain-clustering is speculative and never implies deployment isolation.
